_comment: TradingView symbol overrides. The default is BSE:<nse-symbol>, because TradingView's free embed serves BSE data for Indian equities but blocks NSE ('This symbol is only available on TradingView', verified in-browser on advanced-chart, symbol-overview and mini-chart). Add an entry here only for a symbol whose BSE ticker differs from its NSE ticker, or which is NSE-only. A wrong override renders an empty chart, which is worse than no override.
